Our Investment Programme is one of a few value-focused, long-only strategies investing across a broad spectrum of market capitalisations in the developed, emerging and frontier markets in the region. We manage a single investment strategy via our two commingled funds. Our primary goal is to deliver a best-in-class Investment Programme by compounding good returns whilst maintaining a long-term perspective, both in our investment work and in running our business.
